text.title: Action
text.description: create, comment, edit, reopen, archive, delete or attach

text_1.title: Payload
text_1.description: JSON from the Issue Board screen

Create_problem.inputs: @if(less(length(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['title'], ''))), 4), 'The title must be at least 4 characters.', if(empty(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['application'], ''))), 'Pick an application.', if(empty(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['section'], ''))), 'Pick a section.', if(empty(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['description'], ''))), 'Describe what happened.', ''))))

Comment_problem.inputs: @if(empty(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['content'], ''))), 'Write a comment first.', if(empty(outputs('Ticket')), 'This issue no longer exists.', if(not(or(outputs('Is_reporter'), outputs('Is_admin'))), 'You can only comment on your own issues.', if(equals(outputs('Ticket')?['IsArchived'], true), 'This issue is archived.', if(and(equals(outputs('Payload')?['internal'], true), not(outputs('Is_admin'))), 'Only administrators can add internal notes.', '')))))

inputs.name: MailBody
inputs.value:
Hi,

An administrator replied to your issue @{outputs('Ticket')?['TicketNo']} - @{replace(replace(replace(coalesce(outputs('Ticket')?['Title'], ''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>')}:

@{replace(replace(replace(take(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['content'], '')), 4000), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>')}

Open the Issue Board in BIO SAP to answer.

Edit_problem.inputs: @if(empty(outputs('Ticket')), 'This issue no longer exists.', if(equals(outputs('Ticket')?['IsArchived'], true), 'This issue is archived. Restore it first.', if(not(or(outputs('Is_admin'), and(outputs('Is_reporter'), equals(outputs('Current_status'), 'New')))), 'You can edit your issue only while it is New. Add a comment instead.', if(less(length(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['title'], ''))), 4), 'The title must be at least 4 characters.', if(empty(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['application'], ''))), 'Pick an application.', if(empty(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['section'], ''))), 'Pick a section.', if(empty(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['description'], ''))), 'Describe what happened.', if(and(outputs('Is_admin'), not(contains(createArray('New', 'Reopened', 'Triaged', 'In progress', 'Ready for retest', 'Closed'), coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['status'], '')))), 'Pick a valid status.', if(and(outputs('Is_admin'), not(contains(createArray('Urgent', 'High', 'Normal', 'Low'), coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['priority'], '')))), 'Pick a valid priority.', if(and(outputs('Is_admin'), not(empty(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['assignee'], '')))), not(contains(body('Select_admins'), toLower(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['assignee'], '')))))), 'Pick an administrator from the list.', ''))))))))))

equals: @and(not(equals(outputs('New_status'), outputs('Current_status'))), contains(createArray('Ready for retest', 'Closed'), outputs('New_status')), not(outputs('Is_reporter')))

inputs.name: MailBody
inputs.value:
Hi,

Your issue @{outputs('Ticket')?['TicketNo']} - @{replace(replace(replace(take(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['title'], '')), 255), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>')} @{if(equals(outputs('New_status'), 'Closed'), 'has been closed.', 'has been fixed and is ready for you to retest.')}

@{if(empty(outputs('New_resolution')), '', concat('

Resolution: ', replace(replace(replace(outputs('New_resolution'), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '

'))}

@{if(equals(outputs('New_status'), 'Closed'), 'If the problem comes back, open the issue in the Issue Board in BIO SAP and select Reopen.', 'Please try it again. If the problem is still there, open the issue in the Issue Board in BIO SAP and select Reopen.')}

Reopen_problem.inputs: @if(empty(outputs('Ticket')), 'This issue no longer exists.', if(equals(outputs('Ticket')?['IsArchived'], true), 'This issue is archived.', if(not(or(outputs('Is_reporter'), outputs('Is_admin'))), 'You can only reopen your own issues.', if(not(contains(createArray('Closed', 'Ready for retest'), outputs('Current_status'))), 'Only a closed issue, or one that is ready for retest, can be reopened.', ''))))

Archive_problem.inputs: @if(not(outputs('Is_admin')), 'Only administrators can archive issues.', if(empty(outputs('Ticket')), 'This issue no longer exists.', if(equals(equals(outputs('Payload')?['archived'], true), equals(outputs('Ticket')?['IsArchived'], true)), 'The issue is already in that state. Reload the list.', '')))

value.content: Archived the issue. It is kept with its history and can still be found under Archived.
Restored the issue from the archive.

Delete_problem.inputs: @if(not(outputs('Is_admin')), 'Only administrators can delete issues.', if(empty(outputs('Ticket')), 'This issue no longer exists.', if(not(equals(toUpper(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['confirm'], ''))), toUpper(coalesce(outputs('Ticket')?['TicketNo'], '')))), 'Type the issue number to confirm.', '')))

Attach_problem.inputs: @if(or(empty(trim(coalesce(triggerBody()?['file']?['name'], ''))), empty(string(coalesce(triggerBody()?['file']?['contentBytes'], '')))), 'Choose a file first.', if(empty(outputs('Ticket')), 'This issue no longer exists.', if(not(or(outputs('Is_reporter'), outputs('Is_admin'))), 'You can only add files to your own issues.', if(equals(outputs('Ticket')?['IsArchived'], true), 'This issue is archived.', if(greater(div(add(div(mul(length(string(coalesce(triggerBody()?['file']?['contentBytes'], ''))), 3), 4), 1023), 1024), 10240), 'The file is larger than 10 MB.', '')))))

value.content: @{if(equals(outputs('Payload')?['initial'], true), 'Attached a file with the report.', 'Added a file.')}

parameters.emailMessage/Body: @{variables('MailBody')}

body.message: @{if(contains(createArray('create', 'comment'), toLower(coalesce(triggerBody()?['text'], ''))), 'Something went wrong on the server. Nothing was saved - please try again.', 'Something went wrong on the server. Reload the issue to see what was saved, and try again.')}
